items.title: Occidental Petroleum (NYSE:OXY) Reports Upbeat Q2 CY2026
items.summary: Oil and gas producer Occidental Petroleum (NYSE:OXY) reported revenue ahead of Wall Street’s expectations in Q2 CY2026, with sales up 52.1% year on year to $8.07 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $2.40 per share was 29.8% above analysts’ consensus estimates.

items.title: Wall Street Isn't Worried About SpaceX Price Declines
items.summary: SpaceX stock has been weak for weeks.  Analysts are sticking with their price targets.  The average analyst price target for SpaceX stock is about $227 a share, according to FactSet, down $1 since SpaceX reported better-than-expected second-quarter numbers on Tuesday evening.

items.title: The Real Reason Berkshire Sold Every Amazon Share Has Nothing to Do With Amazon
items.summary: Berkshire Hathaway dumped its entire Amazon stake right as the stock was about to explode higher, and the explanation has almost nothing to do with Amazon's business. The real story is buried inside a personnel change that reshaped what Berkshire was willing to own.
